scope: All files under DemoPuentes, including Execution and Comments, logs, scripts, machine evidence, screenshots and two DOCX files
methods: Full text reads or full-file parsing; DOCX text extracted from document XML; all PNGs inspected through contact sheets with selected originals at full size. Hashing inventories files; it does not independently validate their claims.
interpretation: Historical evidence is dated, overlapping and source-specific. Reading all files is not a new approval of all acceptance criteria.

files.review_method: Read all paragraphs and table-cell text from every word/*.xml entry in DOCX; no visual layout claim.
